newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends lower in kerb, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends lower in kerb, seen falling.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended 0.02 lower at 42.15 to the dollar in the kerb market on Wednesday on increased buying of the U.S. currency, dealers said.
The rupee is likely to open down on Thursday, one dealer said.
The State (central) bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed unchanged at 5.10 percent. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
